identity_reason: it is the List inset pane with a control at the end of each row, so its look comes from List and the controls
concept: A settings page of groups as inset panes, each row a name, a sentence and its control, dropping the control under the words when narrow.

root.why: the heading and the groups stack at the section rhythm on a readable measure

title.why: the page heading is the headline size with display tracking at the top

group.why: each group measures its own width so its rows can stack

groupHead.why: the group heading sits over the pane, inset to the text column

groupTitle.why: the group heading is semibold at body size

groupDescription.why: the line under a group heading is secondary at label size

rows.why: the rows sit on one inset level-2 pane

row.why: each row is at least 44px tall with a hairline from the text column

text.why: the name and its sentence stack and take the free width

label.why: the setting name is primary at body size

description.why: the sentence is secondary at label size and says what the setting changes

control.why: the control keeps its own width at the row end
